# Load libraries
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(stars)
library(tmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(knitr)
library(gt)
library(spData)
library(spDataLarge)
```

# Prepare data
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# read in sea surface temperature rasters
sst_2008 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif")
sst_2009 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif")
sst_2010 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif")
sst_2011 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif")
sst_2012 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif")

# read in bathmetry raster
ocean_depth <- rast("data/depth.tif")

# read in West Coast exclsuive economic zones (EEZ)
eez <- st_read("data/wc_regions_clean.shp")
```

# Process data
```{r}
# Stack rasters
sst_stack <- c(sst_2008, sst_2009, sst_2010, sst_2011, sst_2012)
```

```{r}
# Check if coordinate reference system's match
# If not, transform each one to match
if(crs(ocean_depth) == crs(eez)) {
  print("Coordinate reference systems match")
} else{
  warning("Updating coordinate reference systems to match")
  crs(ocean_depth) <- crs(eez)
}

# check if coordinate reference systems match
if(crs(sst_stack) == crs(eez)) {
  print("Coordinate reference systems match")
} else{
  warning("Updating coordinate reference systems to match")
  crs(sst_stack) <- crs(eez)
}

# check if coordinate reference systems match
if(crs(sst_stack) == crs(ocean_depth)) {
  print("Coordinate reference systems match")
} else{
  warning("Updating coordinate reference systems to match")
  crs(sst_stack) <- crs(ocean_depth)
}
```

```{r}
# Find mean SST from 2008-2012
sst_mean <- mean(sst_stack, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Ensure stack includes all 5 rasters
plot(sst_stack)
```

```{r}
# Convert SST from Kelvin to Celsius (hint: subtract by 273.15)
sst_celsius <- sst_mean - 273.15
```

```{r}
# crop depth raster to match the extent of the SST raster
crop_depth <- crop(ocean_depth, sst_celsius)
```

```{r}
# plot ocean depth
plot(ocean_depth)
```

```{r}
# plot crop_depth
plot(crop_depth)
```

```{r}
# resample the depth data to match the resolution of the SST data using the bilinear method approach
ocean_depth_resampled <- resample(crop_depth, sst_celsius, method = "bilinear")
```

```{r}
# Check that the depth and SST match in resolution, extent, and CRS
# If not, convert to match
if(all(res(sst_celsius) == res(ocean_depth_resampled))) {
  print("The resolutions match!")
} else{
  warning("Updating resolutions to match")
  res(ocean_depth_resampled) <- res(sst_celsius)
}

if(ext(sst_celsius) == ext(ocean_depth_resampled)) {
  print("The extents match!")
} else{
  warning("Updating extents to match")
  ext(ocean_depth_resampled) <- ext(sst_celsius)
}

if(crs(ocean_depth_resampled) == crs(sst_celsius)) {
  print("The coordinate reference systems match!")
} else{
  warning("Updating coordinate reference systems to match")
  crs(ocean_depth_resampled) <- crs(sst_celsius)
  if (crs(ocean_depth_resampled) == crs(sst_celsius)) {
    print("The coordinate reference systems match!")}
}
```

```{r}
# stack rasters
stack_test <- c(ocean_depth_resampled, sst_celsius)

#plot
plot(stack_test)
```


```{r}
suitable_aquaculutre <- function(sst_min, sst_max, depth_min, depth_max, species_name){
  # SST reclassification matrix
sst_reclassified <- matrix(
  c(
    -Inf, sst_min, 0,
    sst_min, sst_max, 1,
    sst_max, Inf, 0
  ),
  ncol = 3,
  byrow = TRUE
)

# Reclassify SST
sst_suitable <- classify(sst_celsius, rcl = sst_reclassified)

# Depth reclassification matrix
depth_reclassified <- matrix(
  c(
    -Inf, depth_min, 0,
    depth_min, depth_max, 1,
    depth_max, Inf, 0
  ),
  ncol = 3,
  byrow = TRUE
)

# Reclassify depth
depth_suitable <- classify(ocean_depth_resampled, rcl = depth_reclassified)

# Find locations that satisfy BOTH SST and depth conditions

# Add oyster zone rasters
sst_depth_suitable <- c(sst_suitable, depth_suitable)

# Find locations that satisfy both SST and depth conditions
suitable <- lapp(sst_depth_suitable, function(sst, ocean_depth) sst * ocean_depth)

# Rasterize EEZ data
eez_raster <- rasterize(eez, suitable, field = 'rgn_id')

# create new raster with pixels only in the EEZ zone
suitable_regions <- mask(suitable, eez_raster)

# keep only 1's!
suitable_regions[suitable_regions == 0] <- NA

# Calculate area of each cell
cell_area <- cellSize(suitable_regions, unit = 'km')

# Calculte total area of grid cells within suitable area
suitable_area <- cell_area * suitable_regions

# Find total suitable area within each EEZ
suitable_area_by_eez <- zonal(
  suitable_area,
  eez_raster,
  fun = 'sum',
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Convert zonal results to a data frame
suitable_area_df <- as_tibble(suitable_area_by_eez)

# Join suitable area to EEZ polygons
eez_map <- left_join(eez, suitable_area_df, by = "rgn_id")

# Create map
tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap") +
tm_shape(eez_map) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "area",
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Suitable Area (km^2)")
    ) +
  tm_title(paste("Suitable", species_name, "Habitats\nby West Coast EEZ", size = 1)) +
  tm_scalebar(position = c("left", "bottom")) +
  tm_compass(position = c("right", "top"))
}
```

```{r}
suitable_aquaculutre(11, 30, -70, 0, "oysters")
```

```{r}
suitable_aquaculutre(11, 28.5, -180, 0, "pacific calico scallop")
```
